payload.words: Fans can get co-branded Rebelle Rally x Jiffy Lube swag at participating events including Rebelle U Presented by Pennzoil, the Overland event The Big Thing, Overland Expo East, and Overland Expo SoCal. A digital or printed copy must be presented in person at the participating events and clearly show the invoice number and location of service.
